title: eremurus stenophyllus var. bungei
intro: Eremurus stenophyllus var. bungei, commonly known as the Bunge's Foxtail Lily, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asphodelaceae family. It is native to Central Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Eremurus stenophyllus var. bungei include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic properties, making it useful in alleviating coughs and relieving spasms in the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
